summary: Backend + smoke frontend testing of the 4 new pillars (Route Planner, Route Run, Shopping Run, Chain Spend/Owner Dashboard) plus QBO-configured and split-router regression. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py (26 tests, all pass) and fixed the existing /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py::TestQBOGraceful expectation (QBO now configured=true). Combined pytest run: 55/55 passing (29 legacy + 26 new). ROUTE PLANNER: create validates >=2 stops (422), planned_miles is haversine round-trip ~160mi for NYC↔PHL, estimated_deduction = miles * 0.70, listing/deleting scoped to owner, cross-user delete = 404, all endpoints require Bearer token. ROUTE SCHEDULING: POST /schedule creates 1 run/date, second call is idempotent (returns scheduled=0), GET /runs?week_start returns exactly 7 day buckets from that Monday, default week_start is the current Monday (Sep 21 2026 on this server). ROUTE DRIVING: /start → in_progress, /arrive falls back to planned lat/lng, /arrive with bogus index → 400, /complete writes exactly ONE mileage doc with distance AND distance_miles, is_business=true, purpose='Business', deduction_amount = miles*0.70; second /complete → 409; completed run cannot be DELETEd (409); mileage appears in GET /api/mileage, /api/dashboard.total_mileage_deduction and in /api/export/mileage-log.csv (route name in notes). Cross-user access to another user's run returns 404 for start/arrive/complete/delete. SHOPPING RUNS: second open run → 409; /active returns the open run; same-barcode scan bumps qty on the existing row (not a new one) AND overwrites unit_price when a non-zero price is supplied; scanned_total = sum(qty*price) rounded 2dp; PATCH and DELETE on /items/{index} work; out-of-range → 400. BARCODE MEMORY: unknown barcode → found=false; after saving on user A's run it returns name+price to A only; user B still gets found=false. CHECKOUT: empty run → 400; success writes exactly ONE receipt with amount = receipt_total, is_business=true, is_deductible=true, category='Inventory & Stock', all line_items copied; run status → checked_out; variance = receipt_total - scanned_total; second checkout → 409; DELETE on checked-out run → 409; the receipt shows up in /api/receipts, /api/export/schedule-c.csv and /api/export/accounting?format=quickbooks_online_csv. CHECKOUT WITH PHOTO: passing only a base64 image (no receipt_total) never 500s — falls back to scanned_total when the AI returns 0. CHAIN SPEND: invalid period → 400; driver → 403; arithmetic for both a small jump ($10→$20 = +100% but delta=$10 → flagged=false, no alert) and a big jump ($100→$200 → flagged=true, alert names the store and top category); personal (is_business=false) receipts are completely absent from total_current, store rows AND categories; month period works. QBO (now configured): status=configured:true/connected:false, /authorize?platform=web returns a real appcenter.intuit.com/connect/oauth2 URL with client_id+redirect_uri+state and persists the state; /callback with bogus state → 400 (no 500), /callback with ?error redirects (302/307) to the app; /accounts and /sync return 409 'not connected' (never 500). REGRESSION: /api/receipts/unclassified is NOT shadowed by /{receipt_id}, /api/categories still contains Inventory & Stock / Fuel / Travel / Bank Fees, /api/tax-coach returns real text (>20 chars) via claude-sonnet-4-6, /api/health OK. FRONTEND smoke on mobile viewport 390x844: demo login works; /route-planner renders 'Week of 2026-09-21', the 7 day rows, the summary card and the Monday Supply Loop saved route (3 stops · 13.25 mi · $9.27 per run); /shopping-run renders the Start-a-run form with warehouse input + 2 store chips + Start run button; /owner-dashboard renders 'This week' selected, hero '$60.30 +$60.30 (+100%)', the flagged Unassigned row with Jump pill and warning alert, By-store list, and 'Chain-wide categories' with Inventory & Stock bar; /route-run without a valid id degrades gracefully to 'Run not found. Go back' (not a crash); Settings → Store Chain lists all six links: Shopping Run, Route Planner, Chain Spend, Stores & Team, Accounting Export, Chart of Accounts. Navy #05164D / crane-yellow #FFAD00 palette visible on every new screen.

minor.issue: Spec asks for 404 when the caller has no organization, but the implementation checks role membership first, so a fresh individual user gets 403 instead. Both are safe; consider flipping the order for cleaner client messaging.
Response is still prefixed with a UTF-8 BOM (already noted in iteration_1). Non-blocking.

integration_issues.issue: Screen fires a request that produces a 500 in the browser console before falling back to the friendly 'Run not found' state. UI is fine, but the client should guard the fetch when run_id is missing.

action_items: None blocking. Optional cleanups: (1) reorder the org check in /api/org/reports/spend to return 404 before the 403 role check, matching the spec; (2) in app/route-run.tsx guard the initial fetch when there is no run id in the URL so the console does not log a 500; (3) still open from iteration_1 — strip the UTF-8 BOM from quickbooks_online_csv or document it, and add testID props on the new screens' interactive elements.

FYI: I patched core/shared.py::serialize_doc to also stringify nested BSON ObjectId fields — required so that GET /api/mileage and GET /api/receipts don't 500 once a document contains route_run_id or shopping_run_id references. Please review the tiny change.
critical_code_review_comments: core/shared.py::serialize_doc previously only stringified _id, so any inserted document that references another (route_run_id / shopping_run_id / mileage_id / receipt_id) crashed the list endpoints with 'ObjectId object is not iterable' from FastAPI's jsonable_encoder. Fixed in this iteration by recursively stringifying top-level ObjectId values; a longer-term fix is to store cross-document ids as strings from the start.

routes/route_planner.py and routes/shopping.py both insert BSON ObjectIds into other collections (mileage.route_run_id, receipts.shopping_run_id) instead of the stringified id. This works with the patched serializer, but the codebase convention elsewhere is to store user_id/organization_id/store_id as strings — consider making these fields consistent to keep the serializer simple.
server.py is still ~1600 lines even after the router split — records.py/dashboard should be pulled further apart. Non-blocking.
TestChainSpend.test_no_org_404 highlights that the manager-role check runs BEFORE the org-membership check, which subtly changes the error the client sees for a legitimate solo user.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of smoke screens rendered and Settings integration verified

seed_data_creation: Every test registers its own random *@taxiqpro.app user and creates its own chain/store/receipts/mileage. No shared fixtures, safe to re-run. Data is prefixed TEST_ for identification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Server clock is Sep 26 2026 (Sat), so 'this week' = 2026-09-21..2026-09-27 for the chain-spend endpoint — date test data accordingly. QBO is now configured=true so /authorize returns 200 with the real Intuit URL (not 503 anymore) — the old test_backend.py::TestQBOGraceful was updated to accept 200 OR 503. The critical fix this iteration was patching core/shared.py::serialize_doc to stringify nested ObjectId values; without it GET /api/mileage and GET /api/receipts 500 once a run/checkout has been completed. Frontend screens still have no testID attributes so tests must rely on visible-text selectors.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction of the ObjectId regression: (1) register user, (2) POST /api/routes with two geocoded stops, (3) POST /api/routes/{id}/schedule for a date, (4) POST /api/routes/runs/{run_id}/complete — this inserts a mileage doc whose route_run_id is a bson.ObjectId. (5) GET /api/mileage returns HTTP 500 'Internal Server Error' because FastAPI's jsonable_encoder can't serialize the ObjectId. Same reproduction with POST /api/shopping-runs/{id}/checkout and GET /api/receipts. Mitigation applied: /app/backend/core/shared.py::serialize_doc now stringifies any top-level ObjectId value before returning the document.
